intro: This page lists skill changes from the vanilla game. For a list of player-vs-player skill changes, see PvP Changes. Also see: All Skills

onItems.title: OSkills
onItems.notes:
• The following are skills granted by items, commonly referred to as "Oskills" (Off-class Skills).
  • OSkills allow any class to use a skill, as long as the granting item is properly equipped.
  • Skills granted by OSkills will benefit from skill synergies earned by hard points invested in the skill tree just like the skill point version of the skill.
  • OSkills are not considered Skills of your Class, unless you are the "native" class of the skill.
    • This means OSkills will not benefit from your Class +Skill affixes if you are not the "native" class of the skill.
    • They will also not benefit from Class +Skills belonging to the "native" Class of the Skill, if different from yours, due to a hardcoded limitation of the Diablo II engine.
    • OSkills will benefit from +All Skills and targeted non-Class +Skill affixes such as +Fire Skills.
  • OSkills will only give up to +3 to a skill if the granting item(s) is equipped by the "native" class of the skill. This will be reflected in-game and will only appear as +3.
    • This is a per-character cap, not per-item one. For example, a Barbarian wielding two Call to Arms will see up to +3 on each sword, depending on the item roll, but the actual +Skill benefit is capped at +3 total per skill.
  • Mercenaries cannot use OSkills. However, they do benefit from passive OSkills.

onItems.title: Item-Based Aura Skills
onItems.notes:
• The following are auras granted by items. These auras are always active if the granting item is properly equipped and does not need to be in a skill slot to be active.
  • When a single character or mercenary has multiple items that grant the same aura, the level of the aura granted to that character/mercenary will be the sum of those auras' levels.
  • Auras granted by items do not stack with auras granted by skill points. If both are active at the same time, the higher-level aura will override the lower-level one.
    • A significant exception to the above are Auras with a damage "pulse" - while other benefits of these Auras do not stack, the damage pulse itself will stack. The damage pulse will also duplicate from multiple items granting the same damage aura.
      • For example, an Act 3 Lightning Mercenary wearing two Dream Runewords will have 3 separate Holy Shock pulses - one pulse of the native Holy Shock Aura, and 2 Level 28 pulses from the two Dream items.
  • Auras granted by items are always the level stated on the item(s) and will not benefit from any +Skills from other items.
  • Auras granted by items will benefit from skill synergies earned by hard points invested in the skill tree just like the skill point version of the aura.
    • For Example, a Doom Runeword's Holy Freeze will be improved by skill points spent in Resist Cold, Salvation, and Blessed Aim, the same as a Holy Freeze Aura acquired from skill points.

onItems.title: Miscellaneous Item Skills
onItems.notes:
The following items grant skills passively when equipped, even though they are not auras:

  • Blackoak Shield grants level 11 Chilling Armor
  • Tempest grants level 16 Energy Shield
  • Uldyssian's Awakening grants level 30 Energy Shield
  • Epiphany grants level 18 Energy Shield
  • Hustle grants level 6 Burst of Speed
  • Innocence grants level [8-12] Blade Shield
  • Armageddon's Blade grants level 30 Armageddon
  • Skyfall grants level 25 Thunder Storm

Note that many items have also gained new or improved chance-to-cast effects. For example:

  • Pus Spitter casts Lower Resist on striking
  • Mang Song's Lesson casts Lower Resist on casting
  • Stormspire casts Static Field on striking
  • Head Hunter's Glory casts Amplify Damage on striking
  • Demon Machine casts Multiple Shot on striking
  • Boneflesh casts Bone Armor when struck
  • Skull Collector casts Bone Armor on casting

Skills only obtainable from items: (for more information, See: Item Skills)

  • Blink - Enigma, Naj's Puzzler, Spellsteel
  • Lesser Fade - Spirit Ward
  • Blade Dance - Chaos
  • Bone Nova - The Third Eye
  • Vampire Form - Trang-Oul's Avatar (complete set)

This section lists major mechanical differences from the vanilla game. For full details and a list of numerical changes and other balance adjustments, see the changelog for each skill.

Broad Skill Changes:

  • All characters gain the "Move Only" skill, which simply makes them walk/run toward a location without attacking
  • Improved summon AI
  • Most summons and sentries (traps, hydras) now benefit from +% to Elemental Skill Damage
  • Abilities that reduce monster resistances have been rebalanced and now operate at 1/2 effectiveness when above 99% or below 0% (used to be 1/5 when above 99%)
  • Spells and abilities no longer share cooldowns globally
  • Skill synergies and their positions within the skill tree have been adjusted to streamline skill point allocation (you won't need to respec to play certain builds)
  • Most skill buffs now last a minimum of 5 minutes
  • Summoned minions which wear equipment (Valkyrie, Shadow Warrior, Shadow Master) can now be inspected - use the inspect hotkey while hovering over them with the Unsummon skill

trees.name: Martial Arts
notes: Charge-up skills reworked

• Instead of charges being generated one-at-a-time per charge-up attack and the effects only triggering when consumed, a 3-stage cycle is used:
  • Charge-up attacks immediately trigger the attack's effect which corresponds to the current stage (1-3) and generate charges until the character has that many charges of the attack's type. The first attack will trigger a stage 1 effect and generate 1 charge, the second attack will trigger a stage 2 effect and generate 1-2 charges, and the third attack will trigger a stage 3 effect and generate 1-3 charges.
    • Using 1 charge-up skill will result in 3 total charges per cycle
    • Using 2 different charge-up skills (A,B,B) will result in 4 total charges per cycle (1 from skill A, 3 from skill B)
    • Using 2 different charge-up skills (A,A,B) will result in 5 total charges per cycle (2 from skill A, 3 from skill B)
    • Using 3 different charge-up skills will result in 6 total charges per cycle (1 from first skill, 2 from second skill, 3 from third skill)
  • A finishing move or basic attack may be used after any stage to consume all the charges and trigger an effect for each one, resetting the cycle. If a fourth charge-up attack is used instead, the previous charges will simply expire without triggering anything and the cycle will begin again. Charges expire after 5 minutes if no attacks are used.
Kick attacks now benefit from most damage sources like other attacks and have 1 additional range

skills.name: Conviction
changes: less effective against non-immune enemies and can break higher immunities above level 25
radius is increased and now scales with levels

trees.name: Combat Skills
notes: Holy Nova, Holy Light, Joust, and Holy Sword are new
Conversion has been removed

skills.name: Sacrifice
changes: now causes the slain monster to explode, dealing overkill damage plus 5% of corpse life as half physical and half magic damage
damage to self decreases by 1% per level to a minimum of 3%, and is now affected by PDR

skills.name: Smite
changes: can gain significantly more damage from the Holy Shield pseudo-synergy since it now has damage synergies of its own
no longer applies knockback (in PvE)
indirectly affected by Grief having "Adds X-Y damage" instead of "+X damage" like The Redeemer or Astreon's Iron Ward
indirectly affected by Crushing Blow having greater diminishing returns against bosses

skills.name: Holy Bolt
changes: bolts now pierce all allies and enemies, healing or damaging each
fires an additional holy bolt at levels 15 and 25, can shotgun nearby enemies

skills.name: Zeal
changes: 3 hits per attack instead of 5 (helps avoid animation lock)
now gains +20% melee splash radius on the second attack and +40% on the third

skills.name: Charge
changes: now gains up to +60% increased melee splash radius based on the distance traveled
now works in melee range instead of doing a normal attack

skills.name: Vengeance
changes: reworked to create triple-element explosions which may chain toward nearby enemies; carries any elemental damage from items

skills.name: Blessed Hammer
changes: hammers now travel faster and have larger hitboxes

skills.name: Holy Sword
changes: new skill that grants block chance and bonus damage against demons/undead for two-handed swords

skills.name: Fist of the Heavens
changes: holy bolts now damage all creature types (was just undead)
removed cooldown, auto-targeting has reduced range

skills.name: Holy Nova
changes: new skill that heals allies and damages enemies in an wide area, has a long cooldown

skills.name: Holy Light
changes: new skill that heals a single target

skills.name: Joust
changes: new skill that teleports to an enemy and impales them, increasing movement speed for 2 seconds
has a 3.5 second cooldown which can be reduced with hard levels (minimum of 1.5 seconds)

trees.name: Cold Spells
notes: Frozen Armor has been replaced with Cold Enchant
Ice Barrage is new

skills.name: Ice Bolt
changes: faster missile speed

skills.name: Cold Enchant
changes: new skill which replaces Frozen Armor and is useable alongside Enchant Fire

skills.name: Ice Blast
changes: pierces, faster missiles

skills.name: Chilling Armor
changes: creates single blizzard spike per counter ranged attack
chills melee on successful strike

skills.name: Glacial Spike
changes: freeze duration is now 2 seconds and doesn't scale with levels
radius increased by 20%

skills.name: Blizzard
changes: improved ground density, projectile hitbox size increased by 50%

skills.name: Frozen Orb
changes: removed cooldown and changed to slower "lightning" cast frames
range has been increased by roughly 20%

skills.name: Cold Mastery
changes: now also adds cold damage

skills.name: Ice Barrage
changes: new skill that shoots up to 5 ice lances which have AOE impact that chill (lances don't pierce, but they do shotgun)

skills.name: Static Field
changes: reduces enemy life to 55%/70%/85% in normal/nightmare/hell (was 0%/33%/50%)
now also has -1% to enemy lightning resistance per level (breaks immunities)

skills.name: Lightning
changes: changed to faster cast frames (was slower "lightning" frames)

skills.name: Teleport
changes: 65% spell damage penalty for 1 second after casting, reduced by 2% per hard level

skills.name: Thunder Storm
changes: no longer flashes your screen
time between attacks goes down with hard levels
casts nova on impact

skills.name: Energy Shield
changes: absorb reduced to 15% +2% per level (was 20% +5%), caps at 80% (was 95%)
synergy from telekinesis nerfed (now has 225%-100% damage taken, was 200%-75%)

trees.name: Fire Spells
notes: Enchant is now Enchant Fire
Combustion and Lesser Hydra are new

skills.name: Warmth
changes: now also adds flat attack rating (10 + 10 per level)

skills.name: Inferno
changes: reduces enemy fire resistance (can break immunes)
has a bigger hitbox and travels faster

skills.name: Blaze
changes: reworked to create an explosion when cast as well as provide a movement speed bonus and "Cannot be Frozen"
increased fire trail hitbox size
duration caps at 10 seconds
now has a 2 second cooldown

skills.name: Fire Wall
changes: duration reduced slightly

skills.name: Fire Ball
changes: explosion radius increased slightly

skills.name: Enchant Fire
changes: renamed from Enchant to distinguish it from the new Cold Enchant skill
is now an aoe skill (similar to battle orders)
now correctly applies 1/3 of damage to ranged attacks
now grants allies 50% of the damage instead of 100%
no longer benefits from +% fire damage twice

skills.name: Meteor
changes: cooldown reduced, meteors fall faster and have 33% larger aoe
now deals an even split of physical damage and fire damage (both are boosted by +% fire damage)

skills.name: Fire Mastery
changes: now also adds fire resistance penetration

skills.name: Hydra
changes: shoots Fire Balls instead of Fire Bolts
duration reduced from 10 seconds to 6 seconds
reduced start-up delay between casting and hydras attacking

skills.name: Combustion
changes: new skill which shoots fire balls in all directions, has a long cooldown

skills.name: Lesser Hydra
changes: new skill that summons hydras which shoot fire bolts
